package.description: A tool for gltf/glb models compression.

en-US.description: A tool for gltf/glb models compression.
en-US.longDescription: Manyi-transformer is a multi-platform model compression client based on Electron, React, gltf-transform, and sharp. It provides a graphical interface for users to easily compress individual glTF/GLB model files and perform batch compression.
en-US.name: Manyi Transformer
